body.name: \psi_{c\ell}
body.construction: For \(o=(x,u,\delta)\), define \[\psi_{c\ell}(o;Q_c,G_c)=Q_c(t_{c\ell}\mid x)\left[1-\left\{\frac{\mathbf 1(u\le t_{c\ell},\delta=1)}{Q_c(u\mid x)G_c(u\mid x)}-\int_{(0,t_{c\ell}\wedge u]}\frac{\Lambda_c(ds\mid x)}{Q_c(s\mid x)G_c(s\mid x)}\right\}\right].\] Here \(Q_c\) is right-continuous, \(G_c\) is left-continuous, \(\Delta_{ci}=\mathbf 1\{T_{ci}\le C_{ci}\}\), and the product-integral convention is \(0/0=1\).
